children: Toronto, Ontario – TheNewswire - November 26, 2026 – Peter Marrone (the “Acquiror”) announces that he has acquired 1,415,094 units (the “Units”) of Sendero Resources Corp.
(“Sendero”) pursuant to its non-brokered private placement completed on November 24, 2026, at a price of $0.53 per Unit for aggregate consideration of $749,999.82.

Each Unit consists of one common share of Sendero (a “Common Share”) and one common share purchase warrant (a “Warrant”). Each Warrant entitles the holder to acquire one additional Common Share at a price of $0.70 until November 24, 2029.

Immediately prior to the acquisition, the Acquiror held 2,156,966 Common Shares and 1,666,666 Warrants, representing approximately 7.96% of Sendero's issued and outstanding Common Shares on an undiluted basis and 13.29% on a partially diluted basis.

Following the acquisition, the Acquiror holds 3,572,060 Common Shares and 3,081,760 Warrants, representing approximately 11.60% of Sendero's issued and outstanding Common Shares on an undiluted basis and 19.64% on a partially diluted basis.

The securities were acquired for investment purposes. The Acquiror may, depending on market conditions and other relevant circumstances, acquire additional securities of Sendero or dispose of securities held by him from time to time.
An early warning report in respect of the acquisition will be filed under Sendero's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca. A copy may also be obtained by contacting the individual identified below.

title: Peter Marrone Announces Acquisition Of Securities Of Sendero Resources Corp.
